clips.title: The story
paras: Off the Darkshore coast, Silver Dawning's Lockbox lies in the wreck of a ship lost to coastal murlocs. Inside are the fallen captain's personal effects and ship log.

The Silver Dawning sailed across the sea toward Auberdine when coastal murlocs attacked. They drove the ship beneath the waves north of the harbor, and the captain died in the assault. The flooded hull still holds the captain's personal lockbox, with the ship's log and private belongings inside. Recovering them could bring a final measure of peace to the surviving crew ashore.
